mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(item_count), 0) AS itemCount, COALESCE(SUM(goods_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(payable_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount FROM sales_order WHERE business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}

SELECT 0 AS orderCount, NULL AS itemCount, NULL AS salesAmount, NULL AS discountAmount, NULL AS netSalesAmount, NULL AS costAmount, COALESCE(r.refundAmount, 0) AS refundAmount, COALESCE(c.returnCostAmount, 0) AS returnCostAmount FROM (SELECT 1) x LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(refund_amount) AS refundAmount FROM return_order WHERE business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(roi.cost_amount) AS returnCostAmount FROM return_order_item roi JOIN return_order ro ON ro.id = roi.return_id WHERE ro.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}) c ON 1 = 1

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(business_date, '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS groupKey, business_date AS bizDate, NULL AS bizDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(item_count), 0) AS itemCount, COALESCE(SUM(goods_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(payable_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, NULL AS returnCount FROM sales_order WHERE business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(business_date, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(business_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY business_date

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(t.business_date, '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(t.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS groupKey, t.business_date AS bizDate, NULL AS bizDate, 0 AS orderCount, NULL AS itemCount, NULL AS salesAmount, NULL AS discountAmount, NULL AS netSalesAmount, NULL AS costAmount, COALESCE(SUM(t.refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount, COALESCE(SUM(t.return_cost_amount), 0) AS returnCostAmount, COUNT(*) AS returnCount FROM ( SELECT ro.id, ro.business_date, ro.refund_amount, COALESCE(ri.return_cost_amount, 0) AS return_cost_amount FROM return_order ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT return_id, SUM(cost_amount) AS return_cost_amount FROM return_order_item GROUP BY return_id) ri ON ri.return_id = ro.id WHERE ro.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} ) t
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.business_date, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY t.business_date
ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(t.business_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY t.business_date

SELECT soi.goods_id AS goodsId, soi.goods_name AS goodsName, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(soi.amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = soi.order_id WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND soi.goods_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY soi.goods_id, soi.goods_name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC, qty DESC LIMIT #{topN}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 'SUBMITTED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_check_order WHERE status = 'PENDING_AUDIT'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory i JOIN goods g ON g.id = i.goods_id WHERE g.status = 1 AND i.quantity <= 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND expect_date < CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory i JOIN goods g ON g.id = i.goods_id WHERE g.status = 1 AND i.quantity <= g.safety_stock_lower

SELECT pr.pay_type AS groupKey, NULL AS bizDate, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.order_id) AS orderCount, NULL AS itemCount, NULL AS salesAmount, NULL AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, NULL AS costAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, NULL AS returnCount FROM payment_record pr JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = pr.order_id WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY pr.pay_type ORDER BY netSalesAmount DESC

SELECT CAST(HOUR(so.sale_time) AS CHAR) AS groupKey, NULL AS bizDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.item_count), 0) AS itemCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.goods_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.payable_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, NULL AS returnCount FROM sales_order so WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY CAST(HOUR(so.sale_time) AS CHAR) ORDER BY CAST(HOUR(so.sale_time) AS CHAR)

SELECT so.cashier_name AS groupKey, NULL AS bizDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.item_count), 0) AS itemCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.goods_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.payable_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, NULL AS returnCount FROM sales_order so WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY so.cashier_name ORDER BY netSalesAmount DESC

SELECT CAST(so.counter_no AS CHAR) AS groupKey, NULL AS bizDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.item_count), 0) AS itemCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.goods_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.payable_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, NULL AS costAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, NULL AS returnCount FROM sales_order so WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY so.counter_no ORDER BY so.counter_no

SELECT ro.cashier_name AS groupKey, NULL AS bizDate, 0 AS orderCount, NULL AS itemCount, NULL AS salesAmount, NULL AS discountAmount, NULL AS netSalesAmount, NULL AS costAmount, COALESCE(SUM(ro.refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, COUNT(*) AS returnCount FROM return_order ro WHERE ro.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY ro.cashier_name

SELECT CASE WHEN so.member_id IS NULL THEN 'WALKIN' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS groupKey, NULL AS bizDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.item_count), 0) AS itemCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.goods_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(so.payable_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, NULL AS costAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, NULL AS returnCount FROM sales_order so WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY CASE WHEN so.member_id IS NULL THEN 'WALKIN' ELSE 'MEMBER' END

SELECT NULL AS goodsId, NULL AS goodsCode, NULL AS goodsName, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, NULL AS brandId, NULL AS brandName, COUNT(DISTINCT soi.order_id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(soi.amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.paid_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.profit_amount), 0) AS profitAmount, NULL AS profitRate, NULL AS shareRate, NULL AS stockQty, NULL AS costPrice, NULL AS occupiedAmount, NULL AS retailPrice FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = soi.order_id JOIN goods g ON g.id = soi.goods_id JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC

SELECT NULL AS goodsId, NULL AS goodsCode, NULL AS goodsName, NULL AS categoryId, NULL AS categoryName, b.id AS brandId, b.name AS brandName, COUNT(DISTINCT soi.order_id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(soi.amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.paid_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, NULL AS refundAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.profit_amount), 0) AS profitAmount, NULL AS profitRate, NULL AS shareRate, NULL AS stockQty, NULL AS costPrice, NULL AS occupiedAmount, NULL AS retailPrice FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = soi.order_id JOIN goods g ON g.id = soi.goods_id JOIN brand b ON b.id = g.brand_id WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods g JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT soi.goods_id, SUM(soi.quantity) AS qty FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = soi.order_id WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY soi.goods_id) s ON s.goods_id = g.id WHERE g.status = 1 AND COALESCE(s.qty, 0) < #{threshold}
AND g.category_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT soi.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, soi.goods_name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, soi.unit_price AS unitPrice, soi.cost_price AS costPrice, (soi.unit_price - soi.cost_price) AS unitProfit, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) AS qty, COUNT(DISTINCT soi.order_id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.paid_amount), 0) AS paidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.profit_amount), 0) AS profitAmount FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = soi.order_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.id = soi.goods_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND soi.unit_price < soi.cost_price GROUP BY soi.goods_id, g.goods_code, soi.goods_name, c.name, soi.unit_price, soi.cost_price ORDER BY profitAmount ASC LIMIT #{limit}

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.order_id = so.id AND soi.goods_id = #{q.goodsId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN goods g ON g.id = soi.goods_id WHERE soi.order_id = so.id AND g.category_id = #{q.categoryId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_record pr WHERE pr.order_id = so.id AND pr.pay_type = #{q.payType})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order so WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT so.id AS id, so.order_no AS orderNo, so.cashier_name AS cashierName, so.counter_no AS counterNo, m.name AS memberName, so.sale_time AS saleTime, so.business_date AS businessDate, so.item_count AS itemCount, so.goods_amount AS goodsAmount, so.discount_amount AS discountAmount, so.payable_amount AS payableAmount, so.paid_amount AS paidAmount, so.cost_amount AS costAmount, so.profit_amount AS profitAmount, so.return_status AS returnStatus FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN member m ON m.id = so.member_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY so.sale_time DESC, so.id DESC
